_comment: WORDS for every Rosetta refusal reason, job stop and cancel note a person may read (WORKORDER-rosettaLoginPolish-111126 #5). Each is a sentence in plain words: it starts with a capital, ends with a full stop, and names no camelCase key, field name or status name; the machine name travels beside it in the answer (refusalName, stopReasonName, status), never inside it. {slot} names are filled by rosettaReasonWords.reasonOf, which throws on a slot not given. rosettaReasonWords checks every entry at load and refuses to start on one that is not a sentence. A vendor fault's words are here under its own faultName (review S2); rosettaJudgedSettings.json's vendorFaultRowList and unnamedVendorFault carry only pattern and policy, and rosettaJudgeEngine refuses to load if a fault has no words here.
